local_reconstructability_constraint.description: Constraints required for local reconstructability using Xi.

constraints.name: window_interior_constraint
constraints.statement: State deviation epsilon must satisfy epsilon > epsilon_threshold to avoid boundary information loss.

constraints.name: orientation_rank_constraint
constraints.statement: The orientation signature -(i) must be unique within the metric equivalence class.

constraints.name: finite_history_constraint
constraints.statement: Iteration count N must remain below the recursive loss horizon defined in RRA-1.0.
